comment.body: Thanks for reporting that Mouse Highlighter is “on” after login or opening PowerToys. The report does not distinguish the enabled Settings toggle from the highlight visual actually appearing without the shortcut. Could you confirm current version, toggle state, and whether the visual effect appears before pressing its configured shortcut? This determines whether startup behavior is incorrect; no logs are needed.
